host = os.environ['IMAP_HOST']

typ, data = client.login('archive', pw)

typ, data = client.select('INBOX', readonly=True)
assert typ == 'OK' and data == [b'2'], (typ, data)

    meta, raw = part
    match = re.search(rb'FLAGS \(([^)]*)\)', meta)
    flags = match.group(1).decode() if match else ''
    msg = email.message_from_bytes(raw)
    body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode().strip()

typ, status = client.status('INBOX', '(MESSAGES UNSEEN)')
assert typ == 'OK'
print('STATUS=' + status[0].decode())
assert b'MESSAGES 2' in status[0] and b'UNSEEN 1' in status[0], status

    assert typ == 'OK', (typ, fetched)
    part = next(x for x in fetched if isinstance(x, tuple))
    meta, raw = part
    match = re.search(rb'FLAGS \(([^)]*)\)', meta)
    flags = match.group(1).decode() if match else ''
    msg = email.message_from_bytes(raw)
    body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode().strip()
    print(f'SEQ={seq.decode()} MESSAGE_ID={msg["Message-ID"]} FLAGS=({flags}) BODY={body!r}')
typ, status = client.status('INBOX', '(MESSAGES UNSEEN)')
assert typ == 'OK'
print('STATUS=' + status[0].decode())
assert b'MESSAGES 2' in status[0] and b'UNSEEN 1' in status[0], status
client.logout()
PY
